name: Can you add an in-law suite without losing all of your backyard?

mainEntity.name: Can you add an in-law suite without losing all of your backyard?
mainEntity.text: Can you add an in-law suite without losing all of your backyard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowners want an in-law suite without sacrificing the entire backyard. That is possible if the design is compact and placed strategically. Garage conversions preserve yard space best because they reuse existing footprint. A small detached suite can also work if it is tucked into a corner or shaped efficiently. The tradeoff is that the smaller the footprint, the more important the layout becomes. Outdoor areas can be preserved by reducing hallways, avoiding oversized rooms, and planning the entry path carefully. In dense Los Angeles neighborhoods, good site planning often matters more than adding more square feet. A successful project should improve the home without making the yard unusable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but the suite size, placement, and access path have to be planned carefully. A compact detached unit, narrow attached addition, or garage conversion can preserve more yard than a large stand-alone structure. The best layout balances livability, privacy, and outdoor space.
